keyFindings.description: A followed-topic message whose delivery mode cannot be read: judgeFollowedTopic returns followedTopicModeUnreadable with no entry (delivery.go:860-861), so the consumer-relayed guard (target != nil) never fires; fanoutRefusalOutcome publishes delivery_failed and records an attempt naming no push. The relay then holds that message for attemptCacheTTL (5 min), blocking the session's later messages, and publishes a second exception. Any publisher can trigger it. Test that must fail: TestServePortRelayRefusesAnUnadvertisedModeTheFanoutAlsoRefused with payload {"delivery":{"mode":"bogus"}}, synced on 'listener delivery mode cannot be read unambiguously': awaitAcked fails, and exactly one exception on notifications.envoy.exceptions.<topic> fails.
